name: The Perfect Human
source:
Ex-idol Seolyeong returns to the entertainment industry as a parasocial fan, in pursuit of art. Or at least something just close enough.

[From [url=https://red-inkcircle.itch.io/the-perfect-human]itch.io[/url]]
